chapter: Band personalities, Duke's last years and the office
title: Mark Niel and the Nielander apartments
summary: Mark Niel, Ivie Anderson's husband, won the lawsuit over her apartment building and took Rose shopping.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Mark Niel was one of Ivie Anderson's husbands, right?
That was her husband when she died.
No. Hadn't she just married someone else?
No, she hadn't divorced Niel when she died.
Oh. Because I remember he had a long lawsuit.
He did have a lawsuit, but he won it, because she was still married to him.
Because he had built that apartment for her, and they called it the Nielander, and the man that she was with when she died ...
Oh, well he tried to claim the apartment building.
But I know Niel ended up getting it all.
Yeah, he ended up getting it. Niel was very nice to us.
He was a very nice man.
Yeah, he was my shopping partner. Every Christmas, he used to take me out to buy Juan's Christmas present. He used to come here regular, didn't he, Juan?
He'd take me anywhere I asked to go -- and didn't mind.
I saw him shortly before he died. I happened to be going past the Nielander and I looked up, and there he was.
